notes.content:

[h3]Check out our latest video when we set the game at 60 fps![/h3]

[previewyoutube=h_O8gVOz2RI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Learn more and support the campaign at [url=https://bit.ly/vanpri]this link[/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500230/c43cd3d298dfe0635214614b7e622c2ddac2b599.jpg[/img]

[h3]We plan to release a version as a Steam DLC or Full Game one day.[/h3]


[h1]Info About Vanguard Princess Mobile Game From Previous Post[/h1]

Here are additional details of the Vanguard Princess mobile fighting game as of March 16, 2025:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500230/ca13e94dafd5ae7a20b61cace1f69ea60af2aa10.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Developed for Android devices with plans for iOS
[*] Touch controls, compatible with game controllers and arcade fight sticks through USB (microUSB)
[*] 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio
[*] Multiplayer is developed with Photon Unity Network 2 (PUN2) with plans for Bluetooth
[*] Frame Delay and Rollback Netcode
[*] 10 classic characters
[*] Additional stages, additional music
[*] Classic and additional artwork
[*] FPS, graphics, and media assets are optimized for mobile devices
[*] Multiple levels of Fuzzy Logic / AI for enemy decision making 
[*] Developed in Unity
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500230/410bce0513e4b3821363af590f45e2702fe72d30.jpg[/img]
